title: Novelty of the real quartet-orbit refactoring
html: Remark. Standard cyclotomic \zeta_5 bookkeeping introduces complex phase ambiguities. A pure real orbit Q replaces this bookkeeping to strictly bound physical observables within the maximal real subfield during Bring's curve reductions. The joint group G = \mathrm{Gal} \times \langle \iota \rangle acting on Q structures the QOU model.
